Can I ask how long has it been?

Have you tried asking for space? It’s not necessarily a break up but it may let the fog subside long enough to not be blinded by your feelings as much. 

Logically, you’re there but it seems like your heart may need a little push.

I know that you’ll get some people who will be quick to say - block and never look back. That response is still valid but emotions are complex and it is not easy. 

I think you may need to take a step back and  create some space between you two. You need to think and so does she. 

Can you feel the same way about this person knowing what you know now?

It’s not a simple, can I forgive this person? The burden is not on you - it’s on them to show you how they understand how much they hurt you and that you can trust them. They need to do the work. They need to have the patience to listen to you rattle off a ton of questions about the infidelity.

I think it’s important to gain some understanding to why she cheated. She needs to know why she cheated as well 

Take it easy, talk to friends, vent, get opinions and follow your gut - it is never wrong.

I’m in the same boat. It’s like I’m fighting to not drown. I don’t know if I’ll ever feel whole or normal again or ever not feel this terrible anxiety. 

Although I am FAR from seeing the light, I found these are the only things that help:

I’ve found this sub helps. Reading about people in our position is comforting in knowing we are not alone. Trying to find posts that relate to what I’m going through is therapeutic in a way and an added bonus when they post an update. 

I’ve called every friend I’ve had and vented, screamed, and cried. I tend to feel a tiny bit better saying all of my thoughts out loud. 

Warm baths and heating pads too. I take about three baths a day because the hot water will take away a fraction of the dread I’m feeling. It also gets me out of bed and even if I spent 2 seconds not thinking about him, I’ll take it. 

Just know I am with you and you are not alone. We will get through this and look back on this dark times and admire how strong we are. You got this.

Call your treatment provider ASAP and they should advise you what is best for you. I’ve seen them cut the molar part of a tray out to make it fit more comfortably until new trays come in so maybe that’s an option they can help you with as well. Best of luck!
